requirements.text: Approximately 2–4 years of professional software engineering experience, with strong practical skills. Exceptional candidates with less experience may be considered if they have outstanding internships or projects.
Full-stack development experience with a clear preference for backend engineering.
Experience building, maintaining or improving production applications.
The ability to get up to speed quickly, investigate bugs and deliver reliable fixes.
Strong coding fundamentals and the ability to reason through technical problems independently.
A genuine passion for music, ideally demonstrated by playing an instrument and having an interest in music theory.
A collaborative mindset and an interest in contributing to product development without needing to own the entire product vision.

This is an in-office position in San Francisco, California, five days per week, with a working rhythm of approximately 9 am to 9 pm. Candidates already based in the Bay Area and those willing to relocate are welcome.
You've built a music-related application, tool or side project because you were personally interested in solving a problem.
You can share a GitHub repository, demo or portfolio of something you've built.
You have experience maintaining backend systems in production and can explain how you've diagnosed and resolved technical issues.
You have worked on consumer-facing applications or products with significant user traffic.
